headline: Saksoft Limited files SEBI Regulation 31(4) substantial acquisition disclosure
sum: Saksoft Limited has filed a mandatory disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations Regulation 31(4), indicating a substantial acquisition event; full acquirer name and consideration not yet publicly confirmed in available sources.
detail: Saksoft Limited, a listed software and IT services company, submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE on or before 19 June 2026. Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011 requires disclosure of any acquisition resulting in a person or group acquiring 25% or more of the voting rights of a listed company, or by existing acquirers acquiring a further 2% per financial year. The actual acquirer name, shareholding percentage, consideration, and deal conditions are not disclosed in the available summary; full details would be in the filed disclosure document itself.
